name: Sovcombank
verdict: 82.8% held by MKAO SovCo Capital Partners and affiliated persons (24 July 2024, AK&M); listed on the Moscow Exchange; US OFAC describes it as privately owned. Nothing found.
note: Official partner of FC Lokomotiv since July 2025 (logo on the front of the playing shirt, below RZD; deal reported as running to 2028). Also partner of HC Severstal. The bank's reported structure (AK&M, July 2024) also lists 6.7% held collectively by sovereign funds of the Russian Federation, the Middle East and Asia; the Russian fund share is not broken out.
